title: Validate FileLab focused MVP and local-first capability boundary
expected_value: Determine whether one local-first adaptive file workbench has enough differentiated demand and technical feasibility to justify a narrow prototype, without multiplying the portfolio by dozens of converters.
next_action: Research comparable tools, select a 4-format MVP boundary, verify local browser/desktop transform feasibility, define privacy and failure boundaries, and return CONTINUE/PIVOT/KILL with evidence.
test_requirements: No prototype build. Evidence must distinguish sourced market facts from hypotheses and include an explicit capability matrix for image, video, audio and PDF paths.
source_evidence: Founder direction in Discord #thecreativeco on 2026-10-09: upload-first FileLab concept covering conversion, compression, extraction and preparation across image/video/audio/PDF.
